title: Underwriting Manual, Cardinal Roadside Assistance: Attaching, Changing and Removing the Option
content:
## 1. Attachment and option rank

1.1 A Cardinal Roadside Assistance option can be attached only to a vehicle scheduled on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, at a rank no higher than the highest roadside option rank the auto policy's package allows.

1.2 Each option carries the rank below; the package must allow at least that rank.

| Option | Option rank | Highest roadside option rank the package must allow |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 1 | 1 or higher |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 2 | 2 or higher |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 3 | 3 or higher |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 4 | 4 or higher |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 5 | 5 or higher |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 6 | 6 |

## 2. Status of the auto policy

2.1 The auto policy status must be bound or in force when the option is added or changed.

2.2 The status is read from the company's record of that auto policy, the policy the vehicle is scheduled on, at the time of the addition or change.

| Auto policy status on record | Add an option | Change (raise or lower) an option |
|---|---|---|
| Bound | Permitted | Permitted |
| In force | Permitted | Permitted |
| Any other status | Not permitted | Not permitted |

## 3. Removal

3.1 The option is removed from the vehicle in any one of these cases:

- (a) the vehicle itself is removed from the policy, and the option goes with it;
- (b) the customer asks for the option to be removed;
- (c) a package change lowers the highest roadside option rank the package allows below the option's rank, and the customer does not choose a lower option.

3.2 Removal is made by the policy service desk; the option's status on the record then shows as removed.

## 4. Worked rank and removal cases (hypothetical)

| Package allows up to rank | Request or event | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | Attach Cardinal Roadside Plus (rank 3) | Within the package: rank 3 is not higher than 3 |
| 3 | Attach Cardinal Roadside Premier (rank 5) | Not attachable: rank 5 is higher than 3 |
| 6 | Attach Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer (rank 6) | Within the package |
| Lowered from 4 to 2 by a package change, vehicle holds Cardinal Roadside Plus (rank 3) | Customer chooses Cardinal Roadside Standard (rank 2) | The vehicle keeps an option, at the lower rank |
| Lowered from 4 to 2 by a package change, vehicle holds Cardinal Roadside Plus (rank 3) | Customer does not choose a lower option | The option is removed |
| Lowered from 5 to 4 by a package change, vehicle holds Cardinal Roadside Plus (rank 3) | None | Rank 3 is not above 4; the removal case in 3.1(c) does not arise |

The package ranks in these cases are illustrative inputs.
